name: Rey
description:
The Rey team is mostly good for doing early phase missions that have a unit requirement, as she works pretty well just with Ben and randoms.
After phase 3 and even on the Zeffo UFU mission, it feels like rolling the dice though, and will often drop waves.
If she does do the UFU mission, manual is the way to go, and stack her with the best possible UFU comp.
notes: Good for special unit required missions
